title: Cartoon Video Creator Input Schema
description: Complete input specification for creating 3D cartoon and animation videos optimized for Google Veo 3.1 with stylized characters, expressive animation, and cartoon-specific rendering

description.title: 1. Scene Description
description.description: Describe the cartoon scene, characters, action, expressions, and mood. Can be in Thai or English — the AI will transform it into an optimized Veo 3.1 cartoon prompt.
examples: ตัวละครการ์ตูน 3D หุ่นยนต์น้อยกำลังวาดรูป
สองตัวละครคุยกันในร้านกาแฟการ์ตูน มี speech bubbles
วิวเมืองการ์ตูนตอนกลางคืน สายฝนตกพรำ
สตอรี่บอร์ด 4 เฟรม นักสำรวจผจญภัยในป่า
A 3D cartoon mime performing invisible box routine

duration.title: 2. Clip Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Duration per clip. Must be 8s when using 1080p/4K or reference images.

aspectRatio.title: 3. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Video aspect ratio. Affects composition and framing.

enumDescriptions.9:16: Vertical — TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts

enumDescriptions.720p: 720p — Faster generation, supports 4/6/8s, required for extension

cartoonStyle.title: 5. Cartoon Style
cartoonStyle.description: 3D cartoon rendering style that determines character proportions, materials, and overall look

enumDescriptions.pixar_3d: Pixar-quality 3D — Smooth skin, large eyes, expressive, family-friendly
enumDescriptions.anime_3d: 3D Anime — Cel-shaded, large eyes, dynamic poses, speed lines
enumDescriptions.chibi: Chibi / Super-deformed — Oversized head, tiny body, ultra-cute
enumDescriptions.claymation: Claymation — Clay textures, matte surface, stop-motion feel
enumDescriptions.toy_figure: Toy Figure — Hard plastic, painted details, collectible look
enumDescriptions.papercraft: Papercraft — Folded paper, layered cutouts, craft materials
enumDescriptions.storybook: Storybook — Painterly textures, watercolor influence, fairy-tale
enumDescriptions.retro_cartoon: Retro Cartoon — Vintage rubber-hose, classic cartoon physics
enumDescriptions.low_poly: Low-Poly — Geometric faceted surfaces, modern minimal

audioMode.title: 6. Audio Mode
audioMode.description: Type of audio to generate with the cartoon video

enumDescriptions.full_mix: Full Mix — Dialogue + cartoon SFX + ambient + music cues (Recommended)
enumDescriptions.dialogue: Dialogue focus with cartoon SFX accents

dialogueLanguage.title: 7. Dialogue Language
dialogueLanguage.description: Language for character dialogue or voiceover

characterCount.title: 8. Number of Characters
characterCount.description: Number of cartoon characters in the scene. 0 = environment-only (landscape/establishing shot). Affects framing and staging.

characterExpression.title: 9. Character Expression / Emotion
characterExpression.description: Primary emotion for the main character. Cartoon expressions use exaggerated features.

enumDescriptions.joy: Joy — Wide smile, squinted sparkling eyes, slight bounce
enumDescriptions.sadness: Sadness — Droopy eyes, quivering lip, single teardrop
enumDescriptions.surprise: Surprise — Eyes popping wide, dropped jaw, raised brows
enumDescriptions.anger: Anger — Furrowed brows, gritted teeth, steam puffs, red tint
enumDescriptions.fear: Fear — Wide eyes tiny pupils, trembling, sweat drops
enumDescriptions.confusion: Confusion — Tilted head, floating question mark, scratching head
enumDescriptions.love: Love — Heart-shaped eyes, floating hearts, rosy cheeks
enumDescriptions.determination: Determination — Gleaming star eyes, clenched fist, power pose
enumDescriptions.mischief: Mischief — Sly grin, one raised eyebrow, sneaky posture
enumDescriptions.sleepy: Sleepy — Half-closed droopy eyes, yawning, Z-marks floating
enumDescriptions.excited: Excited — Bouncing up and down, sparkle eyes, fists clenched

cartoonVoiceTone.title: 10. Voice Tone
cartoonVoiceTone.description: Voice character style for cartoon dialogue. Determines how character voices sound.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on character and style
enumDescriptions.squeaky_cute: Squeaky & Cute — High-pitched, chibi/small character voice
enumDescriptions.deep_booming: Deep & Booming — Large character, bass voice, powerful
enumDescriptions.wise_elder: Wise Elder — Calm, warm, storyteller quality

characterDetails.title: 11. Character Details (Optional)
characterDetails.description: Describe each character's appearance — shape, colors, accessories, distinctive features. Separate multiple characters with |. Example: 'Hero: round-faced boy, blue hair, red cape | Sidekick: small yellow robot, single eye'
examples: Mime: round face, white face paint, black beret, striped shirt, red suspenders
Boy: spiky blue hair, green t-shirt, oversized backpack | Girl: twin red pigtails, yellow overalls
Robot: round blue metallic body, single green eye-screen, stubby arms, antenna on top

dialogueScript.title: 12. Dialogue Script (Optional)
dialogueScript.description: Pre-written dialogue for characters. Format: 'Character: dialogue text'. Separate lines with |. Leave empty for AI-generated dialogue.
examples: Robot: สวัสดีครับ วันนี้เราจะผจญภัยกัน!
Boy: ไปกันเถอะ! | Girl: รอด้วย!
Teacher: มาเรียนรู้กันนะคะ

speechBubbles.title: 13. Show Speech Bubbles
speechBubbles.description: Include visible speech bubbles with text in the video. Best-effort rendering for text in video.

shotType.title: 14. Shot Type
shotType.description: Camera framing. Auto-selected if not specified.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and character count
enumDescriptions.extreme_wide: Extreme wide — Establishing shot, full environment
enumDescriptions.wide: Wide shot — Full characters + environment context
enumDescriptions.extreme_close_up: Extreme close-up — Eyes/detail, comedy beat, reveal
enumDescriptions.birds_eye: Bird's eye / Isometric — Top-down or 3/4 view

cameraMovement.title: 15. Camera Movement
cameraMovement.description: Camera motion style. Auto-selected if not specified.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and style
enumDescriptions.static: Static — Locked camera, classic cartoon staging
enumDescriptions.slow_push_in: Slow push-in — Gradual zoom for emotional emphasis
enumDescriptions.orbit: Orbit — Circle around character for hero reveal
enumDescriptions.crane_down: Crane down — High to low reveal of character
enumDescriptions.whip_pan: Whip pan — Fast snap, comedy timing
enumDescriptions.dolly_zoom: Dolly zoom — Vertigo effect for shock/surprise

cartoonLighting.title: 16. Lighting Style
cartoonLighting.description: Lighting approach optimized for cartoon rendering

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood
enumDescriptions.3_point_soft: 3-Point Soft — Classic studio, minimal harsh shadows
enumDescriptions.flat_bright: Flat Bright — Even lighting, almost shadowless, upbeat
enumDescriptions.dramatic_rim: Dramatic Rim — Strong backlight glow, hero moments
enumDescriptions.golden_warm: Golden Warm — Amber fill, long soft shadows, sunset
enumDescriptions.cool_moonlight: Cool Moonlight — Blue key with warm accents, night
enumDescriptions.neon_glow: Neon Glow — Vivid colored light, cyberpunk/party
enumDescriptions.dappled_forest: Dappled Forest — Broken light through leaves, nature
enumDescriptions.studio_product: Studio Product — Clean white, character showcase
enumDescriptions.campfire_warm: Campfire — Flickering orange from below, cozy night

mood.title: 17. Mood / Atmosphere
mood.description: Emotional tone of the cartoon scene

enumDescriptions.romantic_sweet: Romantic & Sweet — Hearts, soft glow, dreamy
enumDescriptions.nostalgic_retro: Nostalgic & Retro — Vintage feel, warm memories

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood
enumDescriptions.primary_vibrant: Primary Vibrant — Bold red/blue/yellow, high saturation
enumDescriptions.pastel_soft: Pastel Soft — Gentle muted tones, dreamy
enumDescriptions.warm_sunset: Warm Sunset — Amber, orange, gold tones
enumDescriptions.cool_ocean: Cool Ocean — Blue, teal, aqua tones
enumDescriptions.candy_neon: Candy Neon — Pink, cyan, purple, electric
enumDescriptions.earthy_natural: Earthy Natural — Green, brown, warm neutrals
enumDescriptions.monochrome_ink: Monochrome Ink — Black and white with spot color
enumDescriptions.retro_vintage: Retro Vintage — Faded warm tones, film grain

materialStyle.title: 19. Material / Surface Style
materialStyle.description: Surface material and texture for the cartoon rendering

enumDescriptions.rough_clay: Rough Clay — Textured clay with finger impressions
enumDescriptions.felt_fabric: Felt Fabric — Soft textile look, handcrafted
enumDescriptions.glossy_toy: Glossy Toy — Shiny hard plastic, collectible figure
enumDescriptions.paper_craft: Paper Craft — Folded paper, cardboard, layered cutouts
enumDescriptions.painted_wood: Painted Wood — Wooden toy, storybook illustration

useReferenceImages.title: 20. Use Reference Images
useReferenceImages.description: Enable character locking via reference images (up to 3). Forces 8s duration. Preserves character appearance across clips.

sceneMode.title: 21. Scene Mode
sceneMode.description: How to structure the video output

enumDescriptions.single: Single clip — One complete cartoon scene
enumDescriptions.storyboard: Multi-scene storyboard — Multiple clips with transition notes
enumDescriptions.extension: Extension mode — Continue an existing cartoon clip

totalScenes.title: 22. Total Scenes (for storyboard)
totalScenes.description: Number of scenes in storyboard mode. Each scene is one Veo generation.

useTimestamps.title: 23. Use Timestamp Multi-Panel
useTimestamps.description: Enable multi-panel timestamp blocks within a single clip (e.g., [00:00-00:02] panel 1... [00:02-00:04] panel 2...)

negativeElements.title: 24. Elements to Avoid (Optional)
negativeElements.description: List elements to avoid in generation (guidance, not negative prompt). E.g., 'realistic style, dark themes, text overlays'
